text: SHRIRAMFIN.NS has compounded at 27.5% over five years and just posted 45.8% revenue growth last quarter, but the stock sold off 8.4% after its October earnings beat — a classic 'sell the news' reaction that leaves it 11.8% off its high. At a 1.78 beta, it will amplify any Nifty swing, so the 0.38% round-trip cost on your ₹10,000 delivery trade is the least of your worries; the real hurdle is the 20% short-term tax if you exit before a year. For the US side, $10 in fractional NVDA at today's $173.73 buys 0.0576 shares; even at the decade's 63.6% CAGR you'd need roughly four years to 10x, and that assumes zero drawdowns — unlikely with a 28.7 RSI signaling oversold but volatile momentum.
